{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates based on patient_id and sample_seq
# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Confirm the final number of patients
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {df.shape[0]}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_final
print(f"Sentinel values in biomarker_final: {df['biomarker_final'].isin([-999.0, -999]).sum()}")

# Check for missing values
print(f"Missing values in biomarker_final: {df['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum()}")

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = df['biomarker_final'].mean()
print(f"Mean biomarker_final: {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
